## Purpose

Describe the smallest intended change and affected trust boundary.

## Security checklist

- [ ] No credentials, production data, tokens, Terraform state, or private incident material
- [ ] Client input remains untrusted and privileged operations fail closed
- [ ] Workflow permissions remain least privilege and Actions are SHA-pinned
- [ ] English/Spanish and accessibility behavior were checked
- [ ] Tests pass, rollback is identified, and no external cloud activation is included without separate authorization

## Evidence

List safe commit-linked evidence; never paste secrets or customer data.
